title: Motor Base Selector
description: Eight illustrative belt-driven fan cases, in a fixed order, each giving the motor frame, the fan type and arrangement and sometimes the industry. The learner chooses one of five motor base styles and commits it with Check; the correct base and FanPedia's rule appear at once, a reference table of frame ranges and typical mountings opens at any time, and a summary reports mastery (7 of 8 on the first attempt).

educational.topic: Choosing a motor base style for a belt-driven fan
learningObjectives: The learner will apply FanPedia's motor base frame ranges and typical mountings to choose the motor base style for a belt-driven fan, given the motor frame, the fan type and arrangement, and the industry, with at least 7 of 8 cases correct.

rules: Frame number comparisons use the numeric part of the frame designation (326T is 326).
NEMA type slide base: 48 <= frame <= 445. Standard post mount: 48 <= frame <= 215. Pivot/bolted adjustable base: 254 <= frame <= 445.
Heavy-duty slide rails: 440, 500 or 5000 series; a 440-series frame above 445 has only this choice.
Automotive pivot base: Arrangement 9SS, or an automotive application that specifies it.
Eight cases in a fixed order, one attempt each; the correct base is revealed after each Check.
assumptions: Each case has exactly one correct base.
limitations: The cases are illustrative. Bolt-on mounts for tubeaxial, vaneaxial and centaxial Arrangement 9 fans (48 to 286 frame) are not among the five choices.

sources: FanPedia p. 76 (Slide Bases/Rails), p. 77 (Automotive Pivot), p. 78 (Adjustable Bases): frame ranges and typical mountings
Chapter 15, 'Mounting the Motor on a Belt-Driven Fan'; the cases are illustrative

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Procedure practice: frame range, then arrangement, then industry, on eight varied cases with one committed answer each and rule-based feedback.
keyQuestions: Which base styles does this motor frame allow?
Is the fan's arrangement on that base's mounting list?
commonMisconceptions: Any motor up to 449T fits a NEMA slide base.
Post mount and pivot/bolted bases are interchangeable.
Automotive pivot bases can use any motor position.
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score shown as 'First-attempt score: n of 8'; mastery is 7 of 8 on the first attempt.
